title: AS2: type casting functions Number(), String(), Boolean()
description: Verify and test AS2 type casting in the AVM1 compiler. In AS2, Number(x), String(x), Boolean(x) are global constructor calls that convert values. In AVM1: Number(x) → ActionPush x, ActionPush 1, ActionPush 'Number', ActionCallFunction (0x3D); similarly for String/Boolean. Test that these compile to ActionCallFunction (not ActionCallMethod). Also test: 'x as Number' type assertion (compile-time only, no bytecode). Add 6 tests in __tests__/typecasting.test.ts.
